Three business models now compete for the same two million buyers
Dealer brands
67.4% of sales via specialist stores. Accell Germany (Haibike, Ghost, Winora) in insolvency proceedings.
European D2C
Canyon sells online only and grew revenue 6% to €738m in 2025 despite a falling market.
Asian D2C
China again the top source of EU e-bike imports in 2025 despite duties of up to 70.1%.

8 · numbered
MARKETING & ADVANCED AI
8
AI attacks the root causes of overstock and price erosion
01
Demand forecasting by model, size and region to stop overproduction.
02
Markdown pricing that clears specific stock instead of blanket sales.
03
Predictive maintenance from connected-bike data to fill dealer workshops.
04
Theft detection and personalised CRM to build direct relationships.
9 · timeline
MARKETING & ADVANCED AI
9
A three-phase plan builds lifetime value over three years
0–6 months
Simplify range, clear stock via outlet, integrate leasing APIs.
6–18 months
Launch battery-2027-ready models and AI forecasting. Target SME employers.
18–36 months
Refurbished line, predictive service plans, personalised upgrades.

RECOMMENDATION
Compete on safety service and connected ownership rather than price
The next growth phase will come from earning more over each bike's life, not from selling more bikes.

About 3% revenue growth a year to 2031 (EY-Parthenon)
